content.label: AS
content.name: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun

enemies.name: Street Bandit
enemies.flavour_text: Bandits often found in Sargonian cities. Equipped with basic gear, they attack only if necessary.

abilities.text: Movement Speed significantly increases when on Crystal.

enemies.name: Roaming Street Bandit
enemies.flavour_text: Bandits that roam many Sargonian cities. They are experienced fighters who have survived many run-ins.

abilities.text: Movement Speed significantly increases when on Crystal.

enemies.name: Street Hunter
enemies.flavour_text: Hunters often seen in Sargonian towns. Their bows are used for hunting in the wilderness, as well as for 'solving problems.'

enemies.name: Roaming Street Hunter
enemies.flavour_text: Hunters often found roaming between Sargonian cities. Hunters who excel at 'solving problems' naturally find their services in great demand across cities.

enemies.name: Exhibit 237-1
enemies.flavour_text: A curious jewel construct that was believed to be a water pump. Now it runs around with a gem in its...'hand.'

abilities.text: Places Crystal on the first tile without Crystal to significantly increase its Movement Speed.

enemies.name: Exhibit 237-2
enemies.flavour_text: A curious jewel construct that was believed to be a crane. Now it drags a gem around.

abilities.text: Places Crystal on the first tile without Crystal to significantly increase its Movement Speed.

enemies.name: Small Bejeweled Wagon
enemies.flavour_text: A wheeled jewel construct that was once an immobile exhibit. Now it roams the streets, filled with gems.

abilities.text: Drops Crystal on tiles that it passes through.
Upon taking damage, Movement Speed significantly increases for a period of time.

enemies.name: Large Bejeweled Wagon
enemies.flavour_text: A wheeled jewel construct that was once an immobile exhibit. Now it dashes through the streets, filled with gems.

abilities.text: Drops Crystal on tiles that it passes through.
Upon taking damage, Movement Speed significantly increases for a period of time.

enemies.name: Small Broken Vessel
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct resembling a cracked vessel carried by a burdenbeast. As it shambles on, its cracks widen and gems spill out, though it seems unfazed.

abilities.text: Will gradually lose HP over time
Drops Crystals on surrounding tiles upon death.

enemies.name: Large Broken Vessel
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct resembling a cracked vessel carried by a burdenbeast. As it moves, its cracks widen and gems shoot out, yet it remains unfazed.

abilities.text: Will gradually lose HP over time
Drops Crystals on surrounding tiles upon death.

enemies.name: 'Gliding Toy'
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct that can fly. 'The books said it was a toy! Hey, why is it leaking gems?'

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
Drops Crystal on tiles it passes over, losing a percentage of HP with each drop.

enemies.name: 'Gliding Crown'
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct that can fly. 'The books said it was a crown! Who put so many gems on it?'

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
Drops Crystal on tiles it passes over, losing a percentage of HP with each drop.

enemies.name: 'Angry Stampede'
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct with kicks worse than its punches. 'I'm going to kick you.'

abilities.text: Absorbs power from surrounding Crystals to provide Barriers for nearby enemies.

enemies.name: 'Angry Rampage'
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct with punches that match its kicks. 'I'm going to bless you before I kick you.'

abilities.text: Absorbs power from surrounding Crystals to provide Barriers for nearby enemies.

enemies.name: Hall Statue (Left)
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct with hands that glow with radiance. The statue on the left side of the hall now roams the streets, the legacy of ancient Sargon shining bright.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict Arts Damage over a short period (stacks).
ASPD is significantly increased when on Crystal.

enemies.name: Hall Statue (Right)
enemies.flavour_text: A jewel construct with hands that glow with radiance. The statue on the right side of the hall now roams the streets, a testament to the destructive power of ancient technology.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict Arts Damage over a short period (stacks).
ASPD is significantly increased when on Crystal.

enemies.name: 'Unicycle Toy'
enemies.flavour_text: A single-wheel jewel construct, believed to be a children's toy when it sat docilely on its stand.

abilities.text: Attacks two targets simultaneously.
Has a short default attack range, but performs extremely long-range attacks when on Crystal.

enemies.name: 'Bouncing Unicycle'
enemies.flavour_text: A single-wheel jewel construct. Its upper structure once bewildered researchers, but those who have seen its head bounce no longer harbor any doubts.

abilities.text: Attacks two targets simultaneously.
Has a short default attack range, but performs extremely long-range attacks when on Crystal.

enemies.name: 'Bejeweled Slab Defender'
enemies.flavour_text: Strange entities sighted amongst the jewel constructs. No one knows which exhibit they came from, but no one can miss the stone slabs that they wield.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked
Starts with low DEF and RES, but permanently gains DEF when taking Physical damage and RES when taking Arts damage, up to a maximum.

enemies.name: 'Bejeweled Slab Guardian'
enemies.flavour_text: Strange entities sighted amongst the jewel constructs. The bejeweled stone slabs that they carry shine brightly in the night streets, like glowing great swords.

abilities.text: More likely to be attacked
Starts with low DEF and RES, but permanently gains DEF when taking Physical damage and RES when taking Arts damage, up to a maximum.

enemies.name: Mio, the Eager Examinant
enemies.flavour_text: Friend? Foe? Mio doesn't care. Mio does what it must.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts splash damage in a cross.
ATK and HP increase with the number of Crystals on the field, up to a maximum.

enemies.name: Zubayidamu the Timeless
enemies.flavour_text: He stands, an obelisk of the past. Behind him, the possibilities of the future await.

abilities.text: [Crystal Resonance] Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced when on Crystal.
First Form
[Crystalline Focus] Periodically locks onto 3 allied units at most, dealing Arts splash damage in a cross and creating Crystals on the four adjacent tiles.
[Crystal Overload] Periodically fires penetrating beams in four directions, dealing Arts damage to all allied units in their paths and creating Crystals on the tiles they pass over.
Second Form
[Total Defense] Requires channeling. Absorbs power from up to 15 Crystal tiles. When complete, gains a Physical and Arts Barrier proportional to own max HP, based on amount of Crystal absorbed.
[Dead Spot Focus] Requires channeling. Absorbs power from up to 15 Crystal tiles. When casting is complete, locks onto three allied units at most, dealing Arts splash damage in a cross.
